text:
aina: idea  build a narrow gateway compat shim that only translates a few headers and unwraps legacy envelopes. much easier to retire than a runtime shim.

sam: fine but surface-area question: which fields do we map? keep it minimal.

maria: instrument everything. shim should emit shim.trace and per-field drop/null counters. alert if any mapped_field error rate > 0.5% over 24h.

tom: perf: do not JSON.parse body unless header present or tenant flagged. add a 15ms transform budget + circuit-breaker to bypass shim on overload.

sam: also ship 2-line adapter snippets in SDKs for customers that can't set headers.

deploy-bot: canary deployed gateway-compat v0.1 to prod-us-west (1% traffic), logs: /infra/gateway/compat/2026-03-23/

maria: action items: metrics + alerts. sam: SDK snippets. tom: cb + perf guard. we'll check canary in 7 days.
